items.name: Tooltip
items.description: Radix-based tooltip for short helper text.

items.name: Utils
items.description: Shared utilities: cx (clsx wrapper), useId, useControllableState.

items.description: Hierarchy breadcrumb trail.

items.name: ButtonGroup
items.description: Grouped button layout.

items.description: Shared theme-aware details for bar and pie chart marks on hover and keyboard focus.

items.description: Checkbox input with indeterminate state.

items.name: CodeBlock
items.description: Self-contained code display with built-in syntax highlighting — no Prism, Shiki, or Highlight.js.

accessibility.notes: Copy button with polite live region; line numbers excluded from clipboard.

items.name: ColorPicker
items.description: Solid and gradient color pickers.

items.description: Decorative icon in a colored container.

items.name: FileUpload
items.description: Drag-and-drop file upload with file list.

items.name: FluidBackground
items.description: Lightweight pointer-driven iridescent liquid-ink trails using native Canvas 2D — fills any container, stays behind children, transparent by default so the parent owns the background, stops rendering when idle.

accessibility.notes: Canvas is aria-hidden; children remain interactive. Respects prefers-reduced-motion when enabled.

items.name: Heading
items.description: Heading typography scale.

items.name: IconButton
items.description: Icon-only button with tooltip, loading, and variant styles.

items.name: Input OTP
items.description: Separate verification code slots with sizes, paste support, and one-time-code autofill.

accessibility.notes: One labelled native input supports keyboard editing, paste, and one-time-code autofill.

items.name: Input
items.description: Text input with label, hint, error, icons, and size variants.

accessibility.notes: Labelled via FormField; errors use aria-invalid and role=alert.

items.name: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key hint styling.

items.name: Modal
items.description: Accessible dialog modal built on Radix Dialog.

items.name: Notification
items.description: Toast notifications with progress and actions.

items.name: OrbitingPlanets
items.description: Luminous ice-cyan orbital system on native WebGL — soft bloom halos, additive orbit ribbons, pastel spheres with depth occlusion. Transparent by default; static CSS fallback when WebGL is unavailable. No Three.js.

accessibility.notes: Canvas is aria-hidden; children remain interactive. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. touch-action: pan-y preserves scroll when parallax is enabled.

items.name: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation controls.

items.name: Pie Chart
items.description: Responsive pie and donut charts with legends and accessible values.

items.name: ProgressBar
items.description: Linear progress indicator.

items.name: Radio
items.description: Radio group for single selection.

items.name: Select
items.description: Single and multi-select with search, groups, and form field integration.

items.name: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder skeleton shapes.

items.name: Slider
items.description: Accessible numeric slider with single-value, range, vertical, and size variants.

accessibility.notes: Label each thumb; supports arrow keys, Home, End, and page increments.

items.name: Statistic
items.description: Metric display with trend indicator.

items.name: Switch
items.description: Toggle switch control.

items.name: Table
items.description: Sortable data table primitives.

items.name: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed navigation and content panels.

items.name: Tag
items.description: Removable tag chip.

items.name: Terminal
items.description: Visual terminal/console session for documentation — prompts, commands, output, cursor, and chrome. Display-only; does not execute shell commands.

accessibility.notes: Copy button with polite live region; prompts and cursor are presentational and excluded from clipboard payload.

docs.usage: <Terminal shell="bash" commands={[{ command: "npx coloxo add terminal" }]} showCopyButton />

items.name: Text
items.description: Body and caption typography.

items.name: Textarea
items.description: Multiline text input with validation states.

items.name: Toggle
items.description: Toggle button and toggle group.

items.name: Vortex
items.description: Premium GPU spiral particles with soft persistence trails on native WebGL — fills any container, stays behind children, transparent by default. Canvas 2D fallback when WebGL is unavailable. No Three.js or particle libraries.

accessibility.notes: Canvas is aria-hidden; children remain interactive. Respects prefers-reduced-motion when enabled (static frame, no loop).

items.name: WaveBackground
items.description: Interactive 3D-looking wave surface on native WebGL — GPU-displaced mesh with pointer ripples, Canvas 2D / static fallbacks, no Three.js. Fills any container and stays behind children; transparent by default so the parent owns the background.

accessibility.notes: Canvas is aria-hidden; children remain interactive. Respects prefers-reduced-motion when enabled (static frame, no pointer deformation). touch-action: pan-y avoids blocking vertical scroll.
